item.description: Saudi, Omani foreign ministers call for continued diplomacy Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan and his Omani counterpart, Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi, stressed in a phone call on Monday the need to continue the diplomatic efforts aimed at containing the regional crisis, according to a statement issued by the Saudi Foreign Ministry. item.description: Erdogan warns Trump against further attacks on Iran President Tayyip Erdogan said he told US President Donald Trump that he was opposed to further strikes on Iran. "We emphasise at every opportunity that it is possible to resolve these issues through dialogue and diplomacy," Erdogan told reporters on a return flight from Azerbaijan. "Unfortunately, we see a negative shift once again. We are doing our utmost to prevent this."
